PC:
Perform primary survey. Items that are often missed:
a. Maintain c-spine immobilization during airway assessment.
b. Initiate fluid resuscitation (blood or crystalloid).
c. Use modified Glasgow Coma Score (GCS) for non-verbal child.
d. Consider mannitol or hypertonic saline.
e. Obtain vital signs including temperature.
Perform secondary survey from head to extremities and back.
MK: Express differential diagnosis including abusive blunt trauma with mismatch of injury pattern and history provided.
SBP: Activate trauma alert and neurosurgery call.
ICS: During preparation phase assign roles and prepare equipment.
